selection.protocol: No selection by time-to-go, end reason, mobility, or response. Sort eligible seeds by SHA256 salt and seed; select one game per seed by independently salted game ID. First 24 fit, last 12 untouched archive test. All at-risk pre-action states with complete follow-up or a natural physical terminal count equally. H64 primary and H128 sensitivity. First future zero within H moves among boards currently positive. Capped-at-16 or raw count, both log1p, train-standardized, same one-slope ridge logistic model. Entire score ties selected together at largest train alert set with FPR <=1%. No tuning after archive-test observations. Bootstrap entire test seeds, 2000 paired resamples. Report all eligible boards and N>=16 separately.

capped16.loss: sum of unweighted logistic negative log likelihood + 0.5*slope^2

limitations: Predictions describe the recorded behavior after the present board and do not estimate counterfactual action value.
Training-side archive sampling is independent of outcomes but is not representative of all future policies.
Seed-cluster percentile intervals condition on this fitted model; 12 test seeds limit precision.
Each eligible board is weighted equally; neighboring labels overlap and test prevalence is specific to these trajectories.
AP is step-integrated precision-recall with tied scores grouped; AUROC assigns half credit to tied scores.
Alert rates and recall at frozen score cutoffs are per eligible placement; consecutive alarms are not independent events.
